reason: I'm home with the kids all week and there are only so many parks and storytimes, so a calm indoor spot where I can sit with a coffee is worth trying. I'd use the free visit first and then probably do a couple of paid drop-ins before deciding on a pack.
objection: $15 a visit adds up fast when library storytime and the parks are free, and I don't know if it will be worth it after the novelty wears off.
would_change_my_mind: If the free first visit felt crowded or grubby, I'd not come back.
